role: Settings sub-pages for Profile (birthday, fitness level, sex, units, default email recipients, inline email address book) and Sleep (schedule, Apple Health sleep toggles with HRV-stage retro-apply confirmation, split/merge sleep options).

flags.text: Distance units are stored in App Group UserDefaults (UnitsPreferenceStore, key fitness.unitsPreference) while the sibling temperature picker writes UserSettings; the distance choice bypasses SettingsManager.settings didSet, so it posts no flowRecoverySettingsChanged and is not in the settings iCloud backup (no CloudKit code reads UnitsPreferenceStore). SettingsManager.swift:35-38 claims AssistantContextSource listens to that notification for the units preference, but no AssistantContextSource observer exists. Other views read UnitsPreferenceStore.current as a plain non-observable getter.
